coded.code: {CompressedResource} = system.CompressZipFiles(resourcesToArchive: System.Linq.Enumerable.Select(new string[] { {ContentToArchive|list} }, __p => (UiPath.Platform.ResourceHandling.IResource)LocalResource.FromPath(__p)), compressedFileName: {CompressedFileName}, password: {Password:-null}, compressionLevel: UiPath.Activities.System.Compression.Zip.ArchiveCompressionLevel.{CompressionLevel:-Normal}, codePage: UiPath.Activities.System.Encode.CodePages.{CodePage:-Default}, overrideExistingFile: {OverrideExistingFile:-true});

system.CompressZipFiles(resourcesToArchive: System.Linq.Enumerable.Select(new string[] { {ContentToArchive|list} }, __p => (UiPath.Platform.ResourceHandling.IResource)LocalResource.FromPath(__p)), compressedFileName: {CompressedFileName}, password: {Password:-null}, compressionLevel: UiPath.Activities.System.Compression.Zip.ArchiveCompressionLevel.{CompressionLevel:-Normal}, codePage: UiPath.Activities.System.Encode.CodePages.{CodePage:-Default}, overrideExistingFile: {OverrideExistingFile:-true});

notes: ContentToArchive（パス文字列の一覧）は LocalResource.FromPath で IResource にして渡す。API の引数は password, compressionLevel, codePage, overrideExistingFile だけ。FilterFiles はクラスに setter が無く（読み取り専用）XAML でも設定できないので、IR のサンプルにも対応表にも入れない
